Delete a workspace's state from the backend — `tofu workspace delete`. The backend is derived from the configuration as `open` derives it, resolved against the name being deleted, with this call's var and var_file for a backend block or a state encryption that reads a variable (the state is read to count what it holds). Refused for 'default', for a name the backend does not list (`list` shows them), for a workspace open here, for one a convergence holds, and for one whose state holds resources unless force is set (which orphans them). Never touches a configuration directory.

**[Tiers](/docs/reference/server/#tiers):** full

## Annotations

| Annotation | Value |
|---|---|
| `readOnlyHint` | false |
| `destructiveHint` | true |
| `idempotentHint` | false |
| `openWorldHint` | true |

## Arguments

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `config_alias` | string | no | Configuration whose backend this is, as registered by init (omit for the configuration init registered without an alias, 'default', however many others are registered). |
| `backend_type` | string | no | Backend type (e.g. 'local', 's3') for a configuration that declares no backend of its own. Omit to use the declared backend — the normal case. A type contradicting a declared backend is refused; edit the declared block to move the store. |
| `backend_config` | object | no | Backend settings merged over the declared ones per key, these winning — 'tofu init -backend-config=key=value'. The place for credentials and per-environment values the backend block deliberately leaves out; a configuration that declares its backend fully needs nothing here. |
| `backend_config_files` | array of string | no | Backend settings files ('tofu init -backend-config=&lt;file>'), in order, merged below backend_config. |
| `var` | object | no | Root input variable values for this call only — 'tofu -var': what the backend block and the state encryption read. Not kept. A string is the raw text a -var carries; any other JSON value is passed as its HCL literal. |
| `var_file` | array of string | no | Variables files for this call only — 'tofu -var-file', in order, below var. A relative path is relative to the configuration directory. |
| `workspace_name` | string | yes | Workspace to delete — a named state slot inside the backend. Cannot be 'default'. |
| `force` | boolean | no | Delete even if the workspace's state holds resources (orphans that infrastructure). |
